thread:
liz: thanks for joining the all-hands. this thread is for follow-ups on customer wins & losses — short Qs for leadership and owners.

sam: quick signal from sales: multiple deals cited our "predictable latency at scale" pitch. losses called out lack of VPC/KMS options and unclear SLA pricing. examples: enterprise acme corp wanted dedicated billing and per-route latency SLOs.

maria: noted. we have an upcoming private launch P0, but unclear if timeline meets sales asks. can eng confirm target quarter for general VPC/KMS availability?

raj: engineering here — private beta for VPC+KMS starts in Q3, GA in Q4 if no major blockers. Dedicated SLA pricing model TBD; need product to finalize tiers.

maria: ok i'll draft proposed tiers and share by EOD Tue. action: product -> propose SLO tiers + pricing (owner=maria).

emily: question: customers asked for concrete quantization guidance for CPU-only on-prem. can we publish a short handbook or a config recipe?

raj: yes, we can. i'll spin up a short guide: "quantization recipes for on-prem" and link docs PR. ETA 2 weeks.

sam: another ask: evals matter — a loss where our model hallucinated in policy-critical flow. sales wants demonstrable regressions prevented. roadmap ask: make evals first-class per rollout.

liz: agree. research/ML already prototyping per-deployment eval hooks. maria — can we make this a visible roadmap item and include in customer comms?

maria: adding "per-deployment evals + rollout gates" to roadmap. will include sample prompts and a template. target: include in next release notes.

sam: customer ops asked for better error transparency when fallback to smaller model happens. can console show "fallback reason" and token delta cost?

raj: we can add a concise fallback reason field and cost delta metric — low risk. I'll create eng ticket and propose UI change with console team.

liz: prioritize tickets: 1) VPC/KMS GA plan (maria+raj), 2) SLA tiers + pricing (maria), 3) rollout eval hooks (maria+research), 4) quantization docs (raj), 5) fallback transparency (raj+console).

sam: thanks — can we get short owner/ETA updates in this thread? helps triage before next all-hands.

ops-bot: TO-DO created: GH#5421 VPC/KMS GA plan (assignee: raj). GH#5422 SLA tiers (assignee: maria). GH#5423 rollout-eval-hooks (assignee: research). GH#5424 quant-guides (assignee: raj). GH#5425 fallback-transparency (assignee: raj+console).

maria: I'll drop the SLA draft by Tue, and will ping sales for pricing reference signals.

raj: starting on docs + tickets today. will add ETA fields by EOD Fri.

liz: excellent. one last ask — product, please compile 3 anonymized customer quotes (win and loss) for comms. keep PII out. 

maria: will do. adding to GH#5430.

sam: thanks team. +1 to weekly 10-min sync until these are in PR. :thumbsup:

liz: wrap-up: owners — please update tickets and post ETA updates here. we'll review at next all-hands if substantial progress. thanks all!
